name: run-reconciliation
title: Preparation run reconciliation
for_each: select r.id,p.code as name from runs r join pipelines p on p.id=r.pipeline_id

sections.title: Source snapshots
sections.sql: select s.key as dataset,s.value as batch from runs r,jsonb_each_text(r.sources)s where r.id=$1

sections.title: Step counts
sections.sql: select step->>'operation' as operation, (step->>'input_rows')::integer as input_rows,(step->>'output_rows')::integer as output_rows from runs r,jsonb_array_elements(r.steps)step where r.id=$1

sections.title: Prepared records
sections.sql: select o.ordinal as output_record,e.key as field,e.value as value,jsonb_array_length(o.lineage) as source_records from output_rows o,jsonb_each_text(o.data)e where o.run_id=$1 order by o.ordinal,e.key

sections.title: Source row references
sections.sql: select ordinal as output_record,string_agg(ref.value, ', ' order by ref.value) as source_references from output_rows o,jsonb_array_elements_text(o.lineage)ref(value) where run_id=$1 group by ordinal order by ordinal

sections.title: Import evidence
sections.sql: select file_name,checksum,row_count,actor,created_at from batches where dataset_id=$1 order by created_at desc
